literal: To those who are capable of showing kindness without ruining their duty, this world possesses ownership.
translation: This world belongs as a rightful possession to those who are capable of showing gracious kindness without letting their duties fall apart.
modern: தங்கள் கடமை கெடாமல் பிறரிடம் இரக்கம் காட்ட வல்லவர்களுக்கு, இந்த உலகம் சொந்தமாகும் உரிமை உடையது.
explanation: This couplet highlights the delicate balance between duty (karumam) and kindness (kannottam). While showing gracious compassion to others is a great virtue, it must not be done at the cost of ruining one's essential duties. Those rare individuals who can successfully balance both—remaining kind and compassionate without compromising their responsibilities—earn the respect of everyone. To such balanced people, this entire world rightfully belongs.
